subtasks.objective: Build a React-based KDS view in the new URY management frontend using @ury/ui and @ury/core, replacing the legacy-only URYMosaic dependency for kitchen display workflows.
subtasks.acceptance: A KDS route/view exists in frontend/src that loads production-unit KOTs through the existing ury_kot_display.py APIs, subscribes to the existing kot_update_{branch}_{production_unit} realtime channel, renders KOT cards with order/table/user/invoice/time/items/comments/status coloring/audio behavior equivalent to URYMosaic, and supports serve/unserve plus cancellation confirmation actions. Shared display primitives or API helpers added under packages/ui or packages/core are covered by typechecks, and the frontend build passes.
